scanNote:
Culture Clips bo'limining 3-mavzusi: 'Teatime' (choy vaqti). Bosilgan bet raqami: 158.

Betning foni — to'q sariq-yashil rangli, o'rtasida katta qizil atirgul surati.

Betda:
• Sarlavha: '3 Teatime'
• Chapda 'Pre-reading Activity' — 1-mashq (A-F rasmlari)
• 'Reading' — 2a (5 ta savol), 2b (ona tiliga o'xshash so'zlarni topish), 2c (qadamlarni tartibga solish)
• 'How to make a good cup of tea' — A dan F gacha oltita qadam, aralashtirib berilgan
• O'ngda TO'LIQ MATN — britaniyaliklarning choy an'anasi haqida

⚠ A-F RASMLARI 159-BETDA. Shuning uchun 1-mashqni bajarish uchun keyingi betga qarash kerak.

⚠ HALOL IZOH 1: matnda 'Earl Grey from China' deyilgan. Aslida Earl Grey — hudud emas, ARALAShMA nomi (qora choyga bergamot moyi qo'shiladi). An'anaviy ravishda xitoy choyi asosida tayyorlanadi, shuning uchun kitob shunday yozgan. Darjeeling esa haqiqatan Hindistonning hududi nomi.

⚠ HALOL IZOH 2: matnda 'afternoon tea is called high tea' deyilgan. Aslida bu ikki narsa tarixan BOShQA-BOShQA: 'afternoon tea' — soat 4 larda yengil taom; 'high tea' — ishchilar oilasida kechqurungi issiq ovqat. Kitob ularni yaqinlashtirib bergan, lekin 'high tea' da issiq taom borligini to'g'ri aytgan.

⚠ FAKT TEKShIRUVI: '165 million cups' — Britaniya uchun keng keltiriladigan raqam; 'elevenses' — haqiqiy britancha so'z; afternoon tea an'anasi 1800-yillar boshida boshlangan.

exercises.instructionEn: 1  Look at the pictures (A-F). Which shows ... cake? kippers? a sandwich? a pot of tea? biscuits? toast?
exercises.instructionUz: 1  Rasmlarga qarang (A-F). Qaysi birida ... tort? dudlangan seld? buterbrod? choynak choy? pechenye? tost bor?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'PRE-READING ACTIVITY' —
matnni o'qishdan OLDINGI mashq.

⚠⚠ RASMLAR 159-BETDA!

  Oltita rangli surat — choy dasturxonida
  turadigan taomlar.


JAVOBLAR:

  A  — a sandwich  (buterbrod)
  B  — toast       (tost)
  C  — kippers     (dudlangan seld)
  D  — cake        (tort)
  E  — a pot of tea (choynak choy)
  F  — biscuits    (pechenye)


⚠ 'KIPPERS' NIMA:

  'a kipper' = tuzlangan va dudlangan
  seld baliq.

  Ikkiga yorib, ochib dudlanadi — shuning
  uchun rasmda baliq YOYIB qo'yilgan.

  ⚠ An'anaviy Britaniya nonushtasi va
  'high tea' taomi.

  ⚠ Matnda: 'foods such as KIPPERS or
  eggs with toast ... are served'.


⚠⚠ 'BISCUITS' — BrE va AmE FARQI:

     BrE 'a biscuit' = PEChENE (quruq,
        shirin, choy bilan yeyiladi)

     AmE 'a biscuit' = yumshoq bulochka
        (shirin emas!)

     AmE 'a cookie' = BrE 'a biscuit'

  ⚠ Photo File 8-unit varag'idagi 'chips' va Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi
  'lemonade' bilan bir xil holat — kitob
  BRITANIYA ingliz tilida yozilgan.


⚠ 'A POT OF TEA':

  'a teapot' = choynak (idish)
  'a pot of tea' = choynakdagi CHOY

  ⚠ 'a pot of' — idish bilan o'lchash:
     a pot of tea    = bir choynak choy
     a cup of tea    = bir piyola choy
     a glass of milk = bir stakan sut


⚠ SANALADIGAN va SANALMAYDIGAN:

  SANALADI (kitobda ko'plikda):
     kipperS, biscuitS

  SANALMAYDI:
     toast, tea
     ⚠ 'a slice of toast' = bir tilim tost
     ⚠ 'a cup of tea' = bir piyola choy

  IKKALASI HAM:
     cake — 'a cake' (butun tort)
            'some cake' (bir bo'lak)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  teatime    = choy vaqti
  a kipper   = dudlangan seld
  a biscuit  = pechenye (BrE)
  a teapot   = choynak
  a pot of tea = bir choynak choy
  toast      = tost (qovurilgan non)
  a sandwich = buterbrod

pairs.leftUz: A — likobchada ikki bo'lak non orasida go'sht va pishloq, yonida yashil salat va limon
pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'tea is served with a light meal of
SANDWICHES, biscuits, cream cakes or fruit
cake.'

⚠ 'a sandwich' ko'pligi 'sandwichES'
('-ch' → '-es').

⚠ So'z Sendvich grafi (Earl of Sandwich)
nomidan olingan.

pairs.leftUz: B — qora likobchada ikki tilim qovurilgan non, ustiga sariyog' surtilgan
pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'foods such as kippers or eggs with
TOAST ... are served.'

⚠⚠ 'toast' SANALMAYDI:
  'a slice of toast'  ✓
  'a toast'           ✗

⚠ 'to make a toast' — butunlay boshqa ma'no:
qadah so'zi aytmoq!

pairs.leftUz: C — naqshli likobchada yoyib ochilgan pushti-jigarrang baliq, yonida limon va ko'kat
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a kipper' = tuzlangan va dudlangan seld.

Ikkiga yorib, ochib dudlanadi — shuning
uchun rasmda baliq YOYIB qo'yilgan.

⚠ An'anaviy Britaniya nonushtasi va
'high tea' taomi.

⚠ Matnda aynan shu so'z bor.

pairs.leftUz: D — qatlamli biskvit tort, ustida oq krem va sariq bo'laklar
pairs.whyUz:
Matnda ikki xil tort tilga olingan:
'CREAM CAKES or FRUIT CAKE'.

⚠ 'cake' ikki xil ishlatiladi:
  'a cake' = butun tort (sanaladi)
  'some cake' = bir bo'lak (sanalmaydi)

⚠ 'a piece of cake' — ibora sifatida
'juda oson ish' degani ham bo'ladi.

pairs.leftUz: E — gulli naqshli chinni choynak va yonida to'la piyola choy
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a teapot' = choynak (IDISh);
'a pot of tea' = choynakdagi ChOY.

⚠ 2c mashqidagi qadamlarda 'warm the
TEAPOT' bor.

⚠ 'a pot of' — idish bilan o'lchash:
a cup of tea, a glass of milk.

pairs.leftUz: F — likobchada terib qo'yilgan yumaloq jigarrang pechenelar
pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'have a cup of tea and a BISCUIT.'

⚠⚠ BrE 'a biscuit' = PECHENE;
AmE 'a biscuit' = yumshoq bulochka!

AmE da pechenye 'a cookie' deyiladi.

⚠ 'chips' (Photo File 8-unit varag'i) va 'lemonade'
(Photo File 14-unit varag'i) bilan bir xil holat.

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT: Everybody knows that the British drink tea, but did you know that they drink around 165 million cups every day?
exercises.instructionUz: MATN: Hamma britaniyaliklar choy ichishini biladi, lekin ular kuniga 165 million piyola ichishini bilarmidingiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Everybody knows that the British drink
   tea, but did you know that they drink
   around 165 MILLION cups every day? Tea
   is not just a drink, it is a tradition,
   and is PART of the history and CULTURE
   of the UK.

   Afternoon tea is a POPULAR tradition
   that started in the early 1800s when
   people had tea parties in their homes
   or went out to tea shops or tea rooms
   at around 4 o'clock in the afternoon.
   Today, people continue this tradition
   and tea is served with a light meal of
   sandwiches, biscuits, cream cakes or
   fruit cake. In some parts of Britain,
   afternoon tea is called high tea and
   usually INCLUDES a hot dish. It is
   SIMILAR to a cooked breakfast, and
   foods such as kippers or eggs with
   toast as well as cold meats are served.

   Tea breaks are another tradition that
   have become a part of daily life. In
   the past, when workers began their day
   at about 6am, they took a break in the
   morning at around 11am to drink tea and
   have a light SNACK. Today many people
   call this "elevenses" and have a cup of
   tea and a biscuit.

   Nowadays, a wide VARIETY of different
   teas are available and different blends
   are drunk at different times. English
   breakfast tea is taken in the morning
   because it has a strong FLAVOUR and it
   wakes you up ready for the day.
   Darjeeling from India and Earl Grey
   from China are MILD and are best drunk
   with afternoon tea. Herbal and fruit
   teas are popular and are drunk at any
   time of the day.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Hamma britaniyaliklar choy ichishini
   biladi, lekin ular kuniga taxminan 165
   million piyola ichishini bilarmidingiz?
   Choy shunchaki ichimlik emas — u an'ana,
   Britaniya tarixi va madaniyatining bir
   qismi.

   Tushdan keyingi choy — 1800-yillar boshida
   boshlangan mashhur an'ana; o'shanda
   odamlar uylarida choy ziyofati qilishar
   yoki tushdan keyin soat to'rtlarda choyxona
   va choy zallariga borishardi. Bugun ham bu
   an'ana davom etadi: choy buterbrod,
   pechenye, kremli tort yoki mevali tort bilan
   beriladi. Britaniyaning ba'zi joylarida
   tushdan keyingi choy "high tea" deb
   ataladi va odatda issiq taom ham bo'ladi.
   U pishirilgan nonushtaga o'xshaydi: dudlangan
   seld yoki tuxum-tost, shuningdek sovuq
   go'shtlar beriladi.

   Choy tanaffusi — kundalik hayotga singib
   ketgan yana bir an'ana. Ilgari ishchilar
   kunini ertalab soat 6 larda boshlaganda,
   soat 11 larda tanaffus qilib choy ichishar
   va yengil gazak qilishardi. Bugun ko'pchilik
   buni "elevenses" deb ataydi va bir piyola
   choy bilan pechenye yeydi.

   Hozirgi kunda juda ko'p turdagi choylar bor
   va turli aralashmalar turli vaqtda ichiladi.
   Ingliz nonushta choyi ertalab ichiladi,
   chunki uning ta'mi kuchli va sizni kunga
   tayyor holda uyg'otadi. Hindistondan
   keladigan Darjiling va Xitoydan keladigan
   Earl Grey yumshoq bo'lib, tushdan keyingi
   choyga eng mos keladi. O't-o'lan va mevali
   choylar ham mashhur, ular kunning istalgan
   paytida ichiladi.'


⚠ UChTA CHOY AN'ANASI:

  1) AFTERNOON TEA (tushdan keyingi choy)
     — soat 4 larda, yengil taom bilan

  2) HIGH TEA
     — issiq taom bilan (ba'zi hududlarda)

  3) TEA BREAK / ELEVENSES
     — soat 11 larda tanaffus


⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'AFTERNOON TEA' va
  'HIGH TEA':

  Kitob 'afternoon tea is called high tea'
  deb yozgan.

  Aslida bu ikki narsa tarixan BOShQA:
     'afternoon tea' — soat 4 larda
        YENGIL taom (an'anaviy ravishda
        badavlat oilalarda)
     'high tea' — ishchilar oilasida
        KEChQURUNGI ISSIQ ovqat

  ⚠ Kitob ularni yaqinlashtirib bergan,
  lekin 'high tea' da ISSIQ TAOM borligini
  to'g'ri aytgan.


⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'EARL GREY FROM CHINA':

  Darjeeling — haqiqatan Hindistondagi
  hudud nomi.

  Earl Grey esa HUDUD EMAS — bu
  ARALAShMA nomi: qora choyga bergamot
  moyi qo'shiladi.

  ⚠ An'anaviy ravishda xitoy choyi
  asosida tayyorlanadi, shuning uchun
  kitob 'from China' deb yozgan.


⚠ 'ELEVENSES' — QIZIQ SO'Z:

  'eleven' (11) + '-es'

  = soat 11 dagi choy tanaffusi

  ⚠ Faqat Britaniyada ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ Sonlardan yasalgan kam sonli
  so'zlardan biri.


⚠ 'THE BRITISH' — XALQ NOMI:

  'THE British DRINK tea' — KO'PLIK!

  ⚠ 'the' + millat sifati = butun xalq:
     the British  — britaniyaliklar
     the French   — fransuzlar
     the Chinese  — xitoyliklar

  ⚠ Fe'l KO'PLIKDA: 'the British ARE',
  'the British DRINK' ('drinks' ✗).


⚠ MAJHUL NISBAT (matnda juda ko'p):

     'tea IS SERVED with...'
     'foods ARE SERVED'
     'different blends ARE DRUNK'
     'English breakfast tea IS TAKEN'

  ⚠ Qolip: 'is/are' + 3-ShAKL

  ⚠ Kim bajarayotgani muhim emas —
  ish MUHIM.

  ⚠ 'drink' ning 3-shakli — 'DRUNK'
  (drink - drank - drunk).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a tradition = an'ana
  culture     = madaniyat
  to include  = o'z ichiga olmoq
  similar to  = ... ga o'xshash
  a snack     = yengil gazak
  a variety of = turli-tuman
  a blend     = aralashma
  flavour     = ta'm
  mild        = yumshoq (ta'm)
  strong      = kuchli
  herbal      = o't-o'lanli
  available   = mavjud, topiladi
  a tea break = choy tanaffusi
  elevenses   = soat 11 dagi choy
  a hot dish  = issiq taom
  as well as  = shuningdek

exercises.instructionEn: 2  a) Read the texts and answer the questions (1-5), then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  a) Matnni o'qing va savollarga javob bering (1-5), so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL — HAMMASIGA JAVOB MATNDA.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  Around 165 million cups.
     (Taxminan 165 million piyola.)

  2  A hot dish - such as kippers or eggs
     with toast, as well as cold meats.
     (Issiq taom — dudlangan seld yoki
      tuxum-tost, shuningdek sovuq
      go'shtlar.)

  3  Around 11am.
     (Soat 11 larda.)

  4  From China.
     (Xitoydan.)

  5  At any time of the day.
     (Kunning istalgan paytida.)


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (savolning
  ikkinchi qismi — 'explain the words in
  bold'):

  million   = million
  part      = qism
  culture   = madaniyat
  popular   = mashhur
  includes  = o'z ichiga oladi
  similar   = o'xshash
  snack     = yengil gazak
  variety   = turli-tumanlik
  flavour   = ta'm
  mild      = yumshoq (ta'm)
  brew      = damlamoq (choyni)
  teapot    = choynak
  teabag    = choy paketi
  pour      = quymoq


⚠ QISQA JAVOB BERISh:

  Savol: 'How many cups of tea do the
          British drink every day?'

  TO'LIQ javob:
     'They drink around 165 million cups
      every day.'

  QISQA javob:
     'Around 165 million.'

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri. Yozma ishda
  TO'LIQ javob yaxshiroq.

items.textEn: 1  How many cups of tea do the British drink every day?
items.uz: Britaniyaliklar kuniga necha piyola choy ichishadi?
items.whyUz:
Matnning birinchi gapida:
'they drink around 165 MILLION cups every
day'.

⚠ 'around' = taxminan (= 'about').

⚠ '165 million cupS' — 'million' raqam
bilan kelsa KO'PLIK OLMAYDI ('millions' ✗),
lekin 'cups' ko'plikda.

items.textEn: 2  What do people have for high tea?
items.answer: A hot dish, such as kippers or eggs with toast, as well as cold meats.
options: A hot dish, such as kippers or eggs with toast, as well as cold meats.
Only cream cakes and fruit cake.
A cup of tea and a biscuit.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'high tea ... usually INCLUDES A
HOT DISH. It is similar to a cooked
breakfast, and foods such as KIPPERS or
EGGS WITH TOAST as well as COLD MEATS are
served.'

⚠ TUZOQ: 'sandwiches, biscuits, cream cakes'
— bu AFTERNOON TEA uchun, 'high tea' uchun
emas!

⚠ 'as well as' = shuningdek, ... bilan birga.

Matnda: 'they took a break in the morning
at AROUND 11AM ... Today many people call
this "elevenses".'

⚠ So'zning o'zi javobni aytib turibdi:
'ELEVEN' (11) + '-es'.

⚠ TUZOQ: '6am' ham matnda bor, lekin u —
ishchilar KUNNI BOSHLAGAN vaqt.

items.textEn: 4  Where is Earl Grey tea from?
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Darjeeling from INDIA and Earl
Grey from CHINA are mild.'

⚠ TUZOQ: bir gapda ikki choy va ikki
mamlakat bor — qaysi biri qaysiga tegishli
ekaniga DIQQAT qiling.
  Darjeeling → Hindiston
  Earl Grey  → Xitoy

⚠ HALOL IZOH: Earl Grey aslida hudud emas,
ARALASHMA nomi (bergamot moyi qo'shilgan
qora choy).

items.textEn: 5  When do people drink fruit tea?
items.answer: At any time of the day.
options: At any time of the day.
items.whyUz:
Matnning oxirgi gapida:
'Herbal and fruit teas are popular and are
drunk AT ANY TIME OF THE DAY.'

⚠ 'at any time' = istalgan paytda.

⚠ Boshqa choylar aniq vaqtga bog'langan:
  English breakfast — ertalab
  Darjeeling, Earl Grey — tushdan keyin

exercises.instructionEn: 2  c) Can you put the steps in the correct order?  How to make a good cup of tea.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  c) Qadamlarni to'g'ri tartibda qo'ya olasizmi?  Yaxshi bir piyola choy qanday damlanadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTITA QADAM ARALAShTIRIB BERILGAN.

  Vazifa: to'g'ri tartibda qo'yish.


⚠⚠ TO'G'RI TARTIB:

     1 - F   put the kettle on to boil
     2 - B   warm the teapot
     3 - D   put one teabag per person...
     4 - A   let it brew for about 5 minutes
     5 - E   pour into cups and add milk
     6 - C   drink and enjoy!

  ⚠ Ya'ni:  F → B → D → A → E → C


TARJIMASI:

  1  Choynakni qaynatishga qo'ying.
  2  Choy choynakni (issiq suv bilan)
     isiting.
  3  Har odamga bittadan choy paketi
     soling, ustiga 'choynak uchun' yana
     bitta qo'shing va qaynagan suv quying.
  4  Taxminan 5 daqiqa damlanishiga
     qo'ying.
  5  Piyolalarga quying, sut va shakar
     qo'shing.
  6  Iching va rohatlaning!


⚠ NEGA AYNAN ShU TARTIB:

  • Avval SUV qaynashi kerak (F) —
    boshqa hamma narsa shunga bog'liq.
  • Choynak ISSIQ bo'lishi kerak (B),
    aks holda choy sovib qoladi.
  • Choy paketi va suv (D) — asosiy ish.
  • Damlash (A) — vaqt kerak.
  • Quyish va sut (E) — tayyor bo'lgach.
  • Ichish (C) — oxirida.


⚠⚠ IKKI XIL 'KETTLE' va 'TEAPOT':

     'a kettle' = suv qaynatgich
        (suv QAYNATILADI)
     'a teapot' = choynak
        (choy DAMLANADI)

  ⚠ Britaniyada bu IKKI BOShQA idish!

  ⚠ 'put the kettle on' — barqaror ibora:
  'suv qo'ymoq, choy qo'ymoq'.


⚠ 'PER PERSON' — HAR ODAMGA:

  'one teabag PER PERSON'
     = har odamga bittadan

  ⚠ 'per' = har (lotincha so'z):
     per person  — har odamga
     per day     — kuniga
     per hour    — soatiga


⚠ 'ONE FOR THE POT' — AN'ANA:

  'plus an extra one "for the pot"'
     = ustiga 'choynak uchun' yana bitta

  ⚠ Bu — eski britancha an'ana: choy
  quyuqroq chiqishi uchun bitta ortiqcha
  qoshiq/paket solinadi.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (bu ro'yxatda):

  brew   = damlamoq (choyni)
  teapot = choynak
  teabag = choy paketi
  pour   = quymoq


⚠ BUYRUQ GAPI (retseptda):

  Barcha qadamlar BUYRUQ GAPIDA:
     'PUT the kettle on...'
     'WARM the teapot...'
     'POUR into cups...'

  ⚠ Ega ('you') yozilmaydi, fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda turadi.

  ⚠ Retsept va yo'riqnomalar shunday
  yoziladi.

pairs.right: F  put the kettle on to boil
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ ENG BIRINCHI: suv qaynashi kerak,
boshqa hamma narsa shunga bog'liq.

⚠⚠ 'a KETTLE' = suv qaynatgich;
'a TEAPOT' = choynak.
Britaniyada bu IKKI BOSHQA idish!

⚠ 'put the kettle on' — barqaror ibora:
'choy qo'ymoq'.

qaynagan suv birdan soviydi va choy yaxshi
damlanmaydi.

⚠ Bu — britancha choy damlashning muhim
qoidasi.

⚠ 'using hot water' = issiq suv yordamida.

⚠⚠ 'ONE FOR THE POT' — eski britancha

ORTIQCHA paket solinadi.

⚠ 'boiling water' = qaynayotgan suv
('boiled water' = qaynatilgan suv —
farqi bor!).

⚠ 'LET IT brew' — 'let' dan keyin fe'l
ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' YO'Q:
  'let it BREW'    ✓
  'let it to brew' ✗

⚠ Photo File 11-unit varag'idagi 'hear sb DO' bilan bir xil
guruh.

O'qilishi: [po:] — 'r' JIM (Britaniyada).

⚠ Britaniyaliklar choyga SUT qo'shishadi —
bu Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi matnda ham bor edi.

⚠ 'sugar' va o'zbekcha 'shakar' — BIR XIL
MANBADAN kelgan so'zlar!

⚠ ENG OXIRGI qadam.

⚠ 'to enjoy' = rohatlanmoq, zavq olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: 2  b) Read the texts again and find words which are similar in your mother tongue.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  b) Matnni yana o'qing va ona tilingizga o'xshash so'zlarni toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'MOTHER TONGUE' = ONA TILI.

  Vazifa: matndan o'zbek tiliga
  O'XShASh so'zlarni topish.

  ⚠ Bunday so'zlar 'COGNATES' deyiladi —
  bir manbadan kelgan yoki bir tildan
  ikkinchisiga o'tgan so'zlar.


MATNDAN TOPILGAN SO'ZLAR:

  million    — million
  tradition  — tradisiya
  culture    — kultura (madaniyat)
  popular    — populyar (mashhur)
  sandwich   — sendvich
  toast      — tost
  biscuit    — biskvit
  cream      — krem


⚠⚠ IKKITA JUDA QIZIQ SO'Z:

  1) SUGAR va ShAKAR

     Bu ikki so'z HAQIQATAN bir manbadan:
     sanskritcha 'sharkara' →
     forscha/arabcha 'shakar' →
     Yevropa tillariga 'sugar', 'sucre',
     'zucker' shaklida.

     ⚠ Ya'ni 'sugar' va 'shakar' —
     UZOQ QARINDOSh so'zlar!

  2) TEA va ChOY

     Ikkalasi ham XITOY tilidan, lekin
     IKKI BOShQA YO'L bilan:

        DENGIZ yo'li (janubiy xitoycha
        'te') → tea, thé, Tee

        QURUQLIK yo'li (Ipak yo'li,
        shimoliy xitoycha 'cha') →
        choy, chay, chai

     ⚠ Shuning uchun dengiz orqali savdo
     qilgan mamlakatlarda 'tea', Ipak
     yo'lidagi mamlakatlarda 'choy'
     deyiladi.

     ⚠ O'zbekiston Ipak yo'lida — shuning
     uchun bizda 'ChOY'.


⚠ NEGA BU MAShQ FOYDALI:

  Tanish so'zlarni ko'rsangiz, matn
  osonroq tushuniladi.

  ⚠ LEKIN EhTIYOT BO'LING — 'SOXTA
  DO'STLAR' ham bor:

     'magazine'  = jurnal
        ('magazin' — do'kon EMAS!)
     'familiar'  = tanish
        ('familiya' EMAS)
     'accurate'  = aniq
        ('akkuratniy' — ozoda EMAS)
     'biscuit' (BrE) = pechenye
        ('biskvit' — bu yerda boshqa)

  ⚠ Bunday so'zlar 'FALSE FRIENDS'
  (soxta do'stlar) deyiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a mother tongue = ona tili
  similar     = o'xshash
  a cognate   = qarindosh so'z
  false friends = soxta do'stlar

points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu so'zlar Yevropa tillaridan o'zbek
tiliga (asosan rus tili orqali) kirgan.

⚠ Shuning uchun tanish tuyuladi.

⚠ 'culture' — 'madaniyat' ham deyiladi,
lekin 'kultura' shakli ham bor.

⚠ Taom nomlari — eng ko'p o'zlashadigan
so'zlar guruhi.

⚠ EHTIYOT: 'biscuit' britancha PECHENE,
lekin o'zbekcha 'biskvit' — yumshoq tort
xamiri. Ma'nolari BIR XIL EMAS.

⚠ Bu — 'soxta do'st' ga misol.

⚠⚠ HAQIQATAN QARINDOSH SO'ZLAR!

Sanskritcha 'sharkara' →
forscha/arabcha 'shakar' →
Yevropa tillariga: sugar (ingliz),
sucre (fransuz), Zucker (nemis).

⚠ Ya'ni o'zbekcha 'shakar' va inglizcha
'sugar' — bir ildizdan.

⚠ 2c mashqining 5-qadamida shu so'z bor.

⚠⚠ IKKALASI HAM XITOY TILIDAN, lekin
IKKI BOSHQA YO'L bilan:

DENGIZ yo'li (janubiy xitoycha 'te'):
  tea, the, Tee

QURUQLIK yo'li — IPAK YO'LI (shimoliy
xitoycha 'cha'):
  choy, chay, chai

⚠ O'zbekiston Ipak yo'lida — shuning uchun
bizda 'CHOY'.

⚠ Dunyoda choy so'zi qaysi shaklda ekaniga
qarab, o'sha mamlakat choyni qaysi yo'l
bilan olganini bilish mumkin!

⚠ Tanish ko'ringan so'z har doim ham bir xil
ma'noda bo'lmaydi:

  magazine = JURNAL ('magazin' emas)
  familiar = TANISH ('familiya' emas)
  accurate = ANIQ ('ozoda' emas)
  intelligent = AQLLI ('ziyoli' emas)

⚠ Bunday so'zlar 'FALSE FRIENDS' deyiladi.
